decisions.reason: The existing message-184 MODIFY already captures the new fiat-buyer rewards FAQ section and all specified content; no additional change is required.
The existing message-184 MODIFY already replaces the About-page reward-delivery copy with automatic wallet delivery and dashboard/email notifications.
The existing message-184 INTRODUCE fully records automatic non-custodial wallet provisioning, lack of initial seed-phrase setup, and buyer key control.
The existing message-184 MODIFY captures Transak converting fiat and initiating the NFT mint; wallet creation and destination semantics are independently owned by the wallet-provisioning Requirement.
The existing message-184 INTRODUCE already records the required mint/referral number, NFT details, dashboard link, and read action in the certificate email.
The existing message-184 MODIFY already changes confirmation-email display of the mint-number referral code to required for fiat buyers.
Automatic transfer of an existing $5 commission to the provisioned wallet does not change the primary-sale allocation amounts, conditions, recipients, or fee treatment.
The existing message-184 MODIFY fully changes prize collection to automatic wallet transfer, sets the winner wallet as destination, and removes the obsolete claim-page URL.
Linking rewards and tickets to the fiat buyer's NFT and wallet does not specify any change to ownership transfer of the book, referral code, badges, or ticket state.
The read-only PDF.js reader is established by a separate clause in the same message and is not changed by the fiat-buyer reward-access decision.
Minting the NFT into a provisioned wallet does not change the NFT ebook product type or its unlimited-supply model.
The existing message-184 INTRODUCE already records email notification upon a prize win.
